helperSteps: On the computer you're using to view the WebUI, run the helper you downloaded: py {helper} on Windows, or python3 {helper} on macOS / Linux. After signing in to ChatGPT, paste the callback URL the helper shows here. The authorization request expires in {minutes} minutes.
authorized: Authorized to use the ChatGPT plan.
revokeHint: This instance is disconnected. Remote revocation wasn't confirmed, so you can remove the app's authorization in ChatGPT's usage settings.
limitHit: The latest call hit a usage limit. Check which limits apply in ChatGPT.
saveFirst: Save the settings first, then connect the deployer's ChatGPT account.
accountWarning: Although ShiritaiBot uses ChatGPT's official interface for third-party agents, OpenAI may still suspend your account by mistake. We strongly recommend using models from the OpenAI Subscription provider only in your own private chats.
